scientific_integrity: Constructive extension-preserving reduction and an exhaustive small base certified by a published factor-complexity theorem. Standalone checker passes finite instances; no independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: All-length binary regular paperfolding theorem for contiguous minimal absent factors of length at least nine; does not cover arbitrary fold instructions, finite prefixes, or subsequences. The proof uses Allouche's classical factor complexity theorem to certify finite base factor sets. The full 1994 canonical-position paper could not be inspected, leaving an originality risk. 2014-02-24 is the verified first-public date of the arXiv reference; two older print publications have no verified date of first public dissemination.
title: Lacunary minimal absent factors of the regular paperfolding word
